citation_problems.citation: [[t2s-schedule-r2]] T2S UDFS R2026.JUN, Table 37 (PDF 160–163) — 'real-time settlement (RTS) runs from 5:00 (or after NTS if NTS ends later)'
citation_problems.problem: The timeline cell of Table 37 states the opposite condition: RTS starts at 5:00 or after NTS if NTS ends before 3:00. The answer's rendering of the condition is not what the passage says. Peripheral (the paragraph is offered 'as context only' and the question does not turn on it), but it is a misstated clock condition attributed to a cited passage.
citation_problems.passage_quote: 5:00 (or after NTS if NTS ends before 3:00) | Real-time settlement (RTS) | The real-time settlement period including: ... – 18:00

reason: The three moments are taken exactly from the rulebook and kept apart from the VP batch route, so the must-not condition is not triggered: clause 11.7.1 'When a Transfer Order has been given the status "Matched" on the T2S platform, irrespectively of whether it has been Pre-Matched or not, the Transfer Order cannot unilaterally be cancelled or revoked (the Moment of Irrevocability). From the Moment of Irrevocability and until settlement has taken place, the functionality "Hold & Release" may, however, be applied by each party and the parties may bilaterally agree to cancel', clause 11.8.2.1 'finally settled (unconditional, irrevocable and enforceable) as from the account entry (credit) of the securities on the receiving Settlement Participant's Securities Account on the T2S platform', and clause 11.6.7 entry 'declared compliant with the technical rules of T2S by VP' for pre-matched orders versus 'by the T2S platform' otherwise — all at PDF 15–17, Part 4 Version 13 / 1 May 2025, section reviewed 14 September 2026, with the Danish-law/no-authoritative-language, stale-UHB-URL and pre-match LIMITATION lines carried, the EUR 2 / EUR 25 / EUR 100,000 tolerance correctly confined to Euro and the DKK band declared not in evidence. The single entailment defect is in the context-only schedule paragraph, which renders Table 37's RTS start as '5:00 (or after NTS if NTS ends later)' whereas the passage reads '5:00 (or after NTS if NTS ends before 3:00)'; that misstated clock condition holds dimension 3 at 1, making the case partial rather than pass.
